scope: read-only triage of where AGENTS.md (post round-1 shrink, 731 lines) might safely shrink further; no edits to AGENTS.md or other files in this PR

buckets.A_safe_to_extract: stable workflow, can move to skill or dedicated doc; AGENTS.md only needs 1-3 line summary + pointer
buckets.B_watch_first: theoretically extractable but recently load-bearing or actively-evolving; observe before deciding
buckets.C_keep_inline: global hard constraint, single source of truth, or default risk note any agent must internalize

sections.title: Header + What this project is
sections.reason: Foundation; first thing every agent reads.  Project purpose + maintainer pain points.

sections.title: Single source of truth + skill pointers
sections.reason: The single most-important rule in the repo (two authoritative documents + no bug-content duplication).  Already optimised in round 1 to link to both skills for on-demand expansion.

sections.title: Repo layout
sections.reason: Tree itself useful default; per-file annotations duplicate file docstrings + README structure.  Trim to path-only would save ~20 lines but loses at-a-glance anchors.
sections.agents_md_remainder: Tree structure unchanged; pointer to docs/repo-tour.md for per-file purpose annotations.

sections.title: Mission-critical landmines (already shrunk in round 1)
sections.reason: Round 1 shrank this 195 -> 97; further shrinking would regress the deliberate floor of 15 must-internalize conclusions.  The skill carries code/details on demand.

sections.title: Confirmed bugs intro + tier definitions
sections.reason: Tier defs (P0-P5) are 13 lines and globally shared between report, README, test_known_bugs, and both skills.  Extracting creates duplication risk.

sections.title: Static-audit list (14 audits enumerated)
sections.reason: Stable (audit set rarely changes), encyclopedic (most agents never read every audit's blurb), load-bearing only when extending audits or triaging a release.  The single best round-2 candidate.
sections.if_extracted_migrate_to: new dedicated doc docs/static-audits.md (catalogue, not skill -- skills are workflow-focused, this is a catalogue)
sections.agents_md_remainder: 1-3 line summary: 'Static audits live in analysis/audit_*.py and are run by python analysis/run_all_audits.py; catalogue (per-audit description + bugs each found) lives in docs/static-audits.md.  Re-run on every CBDB release.'  Plus the bug-attribution sentence 'audits found Bugs #5 / #6 / #7-9 / #10-12 / #13-14 / #15-19' so the bug -> audit causal chain stays default-visible.

sections.title: Marker-failure policy paragraph (already shrunk in round 1)
sections.reason: Round 1 shrank this; further shrink would lose the (a)/(b)/(c) candidate enumeration agents need to interpret a failing marker test.

sections.title: Index-year cross-check
sections.reason: Single biggest section (35% of file).  User explicitly excluded from skill-ification ('still evolving').  The CONCLUSIONS (~5 lines) belong by default; the PR-history walk (PR G/K1/K2/L/M/N/S/X/Y/Z/AI/AJ, ~175 lines) is encyclopedic but a moving target.  Wait for triage to stabilise.
sections.if_extracted_migrate_to: round 3 candidate -- not now -- would land in analysis/index_drift_cause_analysis.md (already partly there per the section's own pointers) + a thin 5-line conclusion in AGENTS.md

sections.title: Test inventory snapshot
sections.reason: Two compact pytest commands; operationally useful by default.

sections.title: Data-driven testing principle
sections.reason: User's explicit directive ('DO follow it') shaping every test in the suite.  Compact already.

sections.title: Standard workflow after .mdb update
sections.reason: 7-step release recipe; operationally critical when maintainer ships a new .mdb.

sections.title: Open issues / TODOs
sections.reason: Items partly stale: 1-2 done, 3 partly landed, 4 partly addressed (Networks small fixture), 5 done (test_vba_pickers_smoke.py), 6 mostly landed (CmdNeo4j/Pajek/Gephi/GUESS/GISPeople cross-form tests).  Refresh-don't-extract; refreshing against current inventory + roadmap is a separate scope from shrink.
sections.if_extracted_migrate_to: refresh against current inventory + roadmap; if refreshed list duplicates README's roadmap, collapse to a 5-line 'see README §Roadmap' pointer; otherwise keep as a coding-task-shaped sibling to README's product-shaped roadmap.
sections.risk: medium (operational miscommunication if items go stale or get duplicated badly)

sections.title: Operating principles
sections.reason: Six numbered first-principles each reduce the rest of the file's specifics.  Tiny + essential.

sections.title: Key contacts + Memory
sections.reason: Schema docs paths + memory system pointer; trivial size.

round_2_size_guidance.principle: take ONE bucket-A item per round; cap round 2 at ~100 lines net reduction; refresh-but-keep beats extract-and-pointer for B items right now
round_2_size_guidance.round_3_potential: index-year trim (175) + TODO refresh (10) + repo-layout trim (20); requires 2-3 PRs of observation first
round_2_size_guidance.floor_after_round_3: 450-500 lines (single source of truth + tier defs + landmine index + global workflow + first-principles + skill pointers)

constraints_honoured: did NOT propose moving single source of truth, P0-P5 tier defs, or any global landmine conclusion
did NOT propose skill-ifying index-drift triage
did NOT propose large-scale rewrites; ranked list is one-item-at-a-time
conservative observation-biased classification (bucket B for anything ambiguous)
read-only -- no AGENTS.md / README / test / report / driver / skill edits in this PR
